Mutant Feature - Small Horns.name: Mutant Feature - Small Horns
Mutant Feature - Small Horns.description:
🐾 Mutant Features: Small Horns
Two short, smooth horns rising from the upper forehead.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Mutant Feature - Small Horns.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Two short conical horns grow from the upper forehead just inside the hairline, above the outer ends of the brows, angled up and slightly back. Each is about a finger's length, smooth, with faint growth rings near the base. They are pale ivory at the tips, darkening to gray-brown at the base. The hair parts around them.

Visual selection only: this is a permanent Mutant feature of the character's body; keep it consistent in every portrait, even when the Quirk Type is Emitter or Transformation. It adds no Quirk effect, item, license or affiliation; the character's Quirk traits decide what it can do. Two selected features for the same body part (ears, mouth, tail, wings, horns, head or full skin covering) do not stack: draw only the one whose name comes first alphabetically. A Quirkless character has no heteromorph body: if Quirkless or No Quirk was chosen, do not draw this feature.
